findings.passage: Speaking of election integrity, the Save America Act is fine, as far as it goes. But it hardly goes far enough. Votes should be cast in person on election day, except in extenuating circumstances, such as the voter is ill or deployed overseas. Proper, physical documentation - including photo ID - should be required to vote.
findings.note: Campaign issue page 'The Constitution'. Says the SAVE America Act is fine but not far enough. Wants in-person voting on election day with exceptions for illness or overseas deployment, and physical documentation including photo ID to vote. No date on the page; it refers to the 2026 general election.
subjects: mail-ballot limits (in person on election day, with exceptions)

findings.passage: Also, physical, paper ballots should be cast; fully verifiable counting of the vote is essential. We dare not trust in electronic voting.
findings.note: Same campaign page, next sentences. Calls for paper ballots and verifiable counting, and distrusts electronic voting. Raised in the same passage as voter ID.
